handbookNote: Kansas Real Estate Broker license exam. Part of the 2026-09-03 R26 population-tier broker buildout (population order: UT > NV > IA > AR > KS > MS > ID > NE > WV > HI > NH > MT > RI > DE > SD > ND > AK > VT > WY). Exam vendor: Pearson VUE, under contract with the Kansas Real Estate Commission (KREC). Exam mechanics confirmed via Pearson VUE's own official Candidate Handbook #091700 (April 2025, rev 7/25). National/general portion: 80 scored items (+5 pretest), 2.5 hours. Kansas state portion (Broker): 40 scored items (+10 pretest), 1.5 hours. Total 120 scored items, 4 hours. Passing score is a proprietary SCALED score of 70 (0-100), explicitly not literal percent-correct, on EACH section independently -- a candidate who fails only one section retakes just that section within a 6-month window. track_registry models this as exam_question_count=120, exam_duration_sec=14400, pass_percent=70, min_correct=84 (round(120*0.70)), same convention as UT/NV Broker. NATIONAL PORTION (80 items) reuses the exact same real Pearson VUE national item bank as Utah/Nevada -- Kansas's real Broker outline weights are IDENTICAL to Utah's (10/8/10/15/12/9/8/8 across the same 8 sections: Real Property Characteristics, Forms of Ownership/Title, Property Value/Appraisal, Contracts and Agency, Real Estate Practice, Property Disclosures/Environmental, Financing/Settlement, Real Estate Math) -- files copied directly rather than redrafted, a real, confirmed cross-state efficiency (also reused for Idaho and Nebraska this same wave). KANSAS STATE PORTION (40 items, real Broker item counts): Duties and Powers of the KREC (2, incl. the real Recovery Revolving Fund -- K.S.A. 58-3069 per-claimant cap of the lesser of actual damages+attorney fees or $15,000; K.S.A. 58-3068 excess-over-$250,000 redirect to consumer education), Licensing Requirements (3, incl. the real 2-of-3-year/transaction-points broker-experience system under K.S.A. 58-3035(f)), Requirements Governing Activities of Licensees (8), Prohibited Acts (8, K.S.A. 58-3062 grounds + 58-3050 disciplinary process), Brokerage Relationships in Real Estate Transactions Act/BRRETA (15, largest state section -- Kansas's real, distinctive statutory DEFAULT is transaction-broker status absent a written agreement, and Kansas FLATLY PROHIBITS dual agency, using a designated-agency mechanism (K.S.A. 58-30,109) instead), and real Broker-Only Topics (4: licensure exemptions, qualification/denial grounds, trust fund handling incl. the real $100 broker personal-funds allowance under K.S.A. 58-3062(a)(2), broker supervision of primary/branch offices, and commercial RE/out-of-state fee-sharing). Governing law: Kansas Real Estate Brokers' and Salespersons' License Act (K.S.A. 58-3034 to 58-3085) and BRRETA (K.S.A. 58-30,101 et seq.). This bank was drafted across 6 new state-topic drafting passes (the 8 national files were reused, not redrafted). Answers were deterministically rotated into final A/B/C/D position via scripts/tracks/rotate_broker_answers.js.
